proposal_title: Bounded Two-Axis Physical Acceleration within Plain Rectangular Tank as Distinct Second Physical Mechanism

mechanism_classification.mechanism_1: 1D Longitudinal Sloshing with Pitch (nominal A=1.00, prospective A in {0.90, 0.97, 1.10})
mechanism_classification.mechanism_2_proposed: Bounded 3D Two-Axis Physical Acceleration with Coupled Pitch-Roll (preserves plain open-top rectangular tank)
mechanism_classification.disqualified_candidate: Internal Baffle Configuration (introduces internal solid boundaries violating plain-tank operator assumptions)
mechanism_classification.amplitude_endpoint_clarification: Control amplitude variations (A=0.90, 0.97, 1.10) scale body acceleration magnitude along the nominal single axis; they are parametric variations within Mechanism 1 and are NOT counted as Mechanism 2.

baffle_disqualification_rationale.boundary_geometry: Adding internal vertical, inclined, or perforated baffles inserts internal solid boundary particles into the tank interior, transforming the convex simply-connected rectangular domain into a multiply-connected geometry.
baffle_disqualification_rationale.operator_invalidation: The qualified frozen observation operator for F3 plain rectangular tank (f3_legacy_plain_full_transport_config.v1.json, f3_observation_v2.py) strictly presumes an unobstructed 5-wall rectangular box (0.9 x 0.18 x 0.51 m). Its spatial cell integrals, center-of-mass chords, free-surface quantiles (q90 over length), top-open exit definitions, and fluid partition zones assume continuous fluid chords.
baffle_disqualification_rationale.hydrodynamic_artifacts: Internal walls create internal contact lines, wetting hysteresis, local singular shear, artificial wake turbulence, and geometric shadow zones where the plain rectangular integration operator yields non-physical artifacts. Blind reuse of the plain operator on a baffled container is mathematically and scientifically invalid.

proposed_second_mechanism.physical_concept: Bounded two-axis physical acceleration within the exact plain 5-wall open-top rectangular container (0.9 x 0.18 x 0.51 m, depth 0.09 m). The physical fluid domain and boundary surfaces remain identical to the qualified plain container.

kinematics_and_forcing_derivation.linear_acceleration: a_lin(t) = (a_x(t), a_y(t), a_z(t)), where a_x(t) provides the primary longitudinal drive, a_y(t) introduces a bounded transverse drive, and a_z(t) maintains gravitational equilibrium (-9.81 m/s^2) with vertical dynamic coupling.
kinematics_and_forcing_derivation.angular_acceleration: alpha(t) = (alpha_x(t), alpha_y(t), 0), coupling pitch (around Y) and roll (around X) with zero yaw (alpha_z = 0) to avoid artificial rotational drift.
kinematics_and_forcing_derivation.zero_drive_consistency: At t=0, a_lin(0) = (0, 0, -9.81) m/s^2, alpha(0) = (0, 0, 0) rad/s^2, initial linear and angular velocities v_lin(0)=0, omega(0)=0. The transverse component a_y(t) is modulated by a smooth C^2 envelope w(t) to prevent impulsive startup shocks.
kinematics_and_forcing_derivation.coordinate_frame: Tank-fixed computational coordinates; global gravity disabled in solver XML (globalgravity=0) with full gravitational vector included in CSV body forcing.

solver_version_physics.csv_parsing: Official JDsAccInput.cpp loads 7 columns (Time, LinearAccX, LinearAccY, LinearAccZ, AngularAccX, AngularAccY, AngularAccZ) via standard delimited parsing.
solver_version_physics.native_integration: Right-endpoint integration in JDsAccInput.cpp computes v_lin[k] and v_ang[k] natively without external preprocessing.
solver_version_physics.gpu_coriolis_branch: In JDsAccInput_ker.cu, the angular acceleration kernel activates when any component of alpha is nonzero. It explicitly computes full 3D inertial frame terms: Euler acceleration (alpha x r), Coriolis acceleration (2 * omega x v_rel), and Centrifugal acceleration (omega x (omega x r)). No textbook rigid-pose frame simplification is substituted.

observable_and_event_expansion.fluid_dynamics: Excites true 3D sloshing modes: longitudinal sloshing (f_1,0) couples nonlinearly with transverse sloshing (f_0,1), generating 3D swirling waves, diagonal wave runup, and lateral wall pressure peaks.
observable_and_event_expansion.energy_decomposition: Enables physical kinetic energy decomposition into longitudinal (E_kx), transverse (E_ky), and vertical (E_kz) modal components.
observable_and_event_expansion.lagrangian_transport: Induces 3D Lagrangian cross-mixing across the Y=0 symmetry plane, expanding transport metric coverage from quasi-2D longitudinal transport to full 3D residence and transit distributions.
observable_and_event_expansion.free_surface_gauges: Requires bilateral transverse surface elevation tracking along both side walls (Y = +/- 0.08m) in addition to longitudinal centerline probes.

baseline_study_requirements.resolution_ladder: Preregistered spatial convergence study across at least 3 commensurate resolutions (e.g., dp = 0.0075, 0.006, 0.005 m).
baseline_study_requirements.adaptive_timestepping: Verification of genuine adaptive CFL timestepping (CFL 0.05 vs 0.025 with CoefDtMin 0.005) ensuring zero dtmin floor clamping under multi-axis 3D velocities.
baseline_study_requirements.macro_window: Full 8.35s window evaluation verifying energy, momentum, and free-surface boundary compliance within the 5% spatial budget.
baseline_study_requirements.operator_qualification: Rigorous qualification of updated 3D observation operator before accepting scientific claims.

governance_and_claim_boundary.execution_policy: No new control CSVs authored or launched without formal Root pre-registration and review.
